pages.text: The Frontier's clouds are a gas field Earth's air cannot match. A $(item)Cloud Siphon$() touching a Hydrogen, Oxygen or Dust Cloud draws its gas for ever; the cloud is not used up. The Fractionation Spire, run cold, parts out $(fluid)Hydrogen$() and $(fluid)Carbon Monoxide$().

Carbon monoxide and hydrogen make $(fluid)Methanol$(); methane runs the Fuel Cell; hydrogen cyanide and ammonia with a little sugar make an $(item)Amino Acid Mixture$() (the Strecker route); PAH soot makes graphene more cheaply than coal.
